gloss: ice pack; cold pack; coolant pack

definitions.gloss: ice pack; cold pack; coolant pack
definitions.explanation: A gel pack that can be frozen and used to keep things cold. Commonly used for keeping food fresh during transport, cooling injuries, or beating the summer heat.

examples.japanese: {保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put in an ice pack.

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧とき、⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I bought the cake, the clerk included an ice pack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: In summer, wrapping an ice pack in a towel and putting it around your neck keeps you cool.

notes:
USAGE: {保冷剤|ほれいざい} is an everyday word in Japan. Cake shops and other stores selling perishable goods routinely offer {保冷剤|ほれいざい} with purchases. They are also commonly used in ⟦{保冷|ほれい}バッグ→保冷バッグ：25161_horeibaggu⟧ (insulated bags) for picnics and lunch boxes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in an ice pack)
- {保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to include an ice pack)
- {保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}→冷凍庫：14721_reitouko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{凍|こお}らせる→凍る：02100_kooru⟧ (to freeze an ice pack in the freezer)

The word is a compound of {保冷|ほれい} (keeping cold) and ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent/substance). In cake shops, you may be asked {保冷剤|ほれいざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Shall I include an ice pack?).
